situations: Penalty measures include all situations and types.
weighting: Each eligible skater equally weighted within season and NHL position
missingDataPolicy: Eligible records require valid counts. Below-cutoff missing values remain unavailable. Recorded zero remains zero.
netPenaltyPolicy: Penalties drawn minus penalties taken; display context only.
note: Reference data only; no indices or grades calculated. Penalty counts and minutes do not equal power-play opportunities.
